title: Qt: Add accessible name/role/index information
description:
Adds accessibility UI markup for component names, descriptions, roles and component indices.

AI-Assisted: yes (Gemini)

Is deleting this line intentional?( I'm not into ui code).
The IDE says that this call is redundant and it does seem to behave correctly but I am fine with retaining it because I can't 100% explain how it is correct.
If I comment that line out here, the comment button is enabled, but doesn't do anything until I load a capture file.

The button, like all Qt buttons, is enabled by default (unless overridden in a .ui file or when constructed, like here.) You can see that in `MainStatusBar::setCaptureFile()` that the button is enabled if and only if there is a capture file.

It is not redundant because the setCaptureFile signal is not sent upon initial program startup when no file is loaded initially. (Possibly it should be.) So the line should be left in.
